display_name: 独立时域与时频注意力直接 IQ 恢复
description: 不依赖 DURA 的新网络，直接从受损 IQ 重建；仅使用 Phase1 L_s/U_s 配对源信号和 IQ 选模，冻结后使用 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 七视图测试并与 DURA 对照。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发新的 Phase1 星地恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python; GPU 2 if available; two CPU threads

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Six registered Phase1 TX; no TX labels used in training or source IQ selection
data.validation_ref: 4096 fixed sampled L_s/U_s source IDs; receiver 4/6 day3 validation and receiver 8 day3 heldout; all receiver 4/6/8 day3 excluded from training; no V
data.leo_config_ref: Cache epochs 01-10 training and epoch20 validation, seven Phase1 simulated practical scenes; seven fixed final development views

permissions.query_use: Phase1 test only after source-IQ selection frozen and all predictions sealed; no Phase3
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed Phase1 development evaluation; historical test observations mean not independent blind

checkpoint.initialization: new direct IQ network from scratch; no DURA or F weights in training/selection
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: core.data matches source IDs to exact Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Source IQ-only normalized aligned error epochs 2/5/10 and alpha .25/.5/1; receiver 4/6 day3 seven scene group guards 1e-4 clean and 1e-6 impaired; retain raw if no candidate; receiver 8 day3 is heldout and not used in selection

execution.launch_owner: Codex direct axial IQ single owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU 2 only if free, one worker, two CPU threads; preserve other owners
execution.launch_command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261102-phase1-direct-axial-iq-s2026092701-r01-release/experiments/phase1_axial_spectral/phase1_axial_spectral_pipeline.py --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --run-root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261102-phase1-direct-axial-iq-s2026092701-r01 --commit bc9ac03f23271614f332fd06bd86e77a0cd2cca5 --device cuda:0
execution.stop_rule: Only provenance/role violation, output collision, nonfinite or technical execution failure; preserve all partial outputs; no stop for low performance

dimensions: clean and six Phase1 practical scenes
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Target all six restored accuracies >= clean baseline minus 3 pp, also report relative 3% threshold; clean damage <=1 pp; source IQ selection fixed before F or source labels.

rows.method: independent long-range temporal residual plus two-scale complex spectral axial attention, direct raw-IQ restoration; no DURA dependency
rows.seed_notes: fixed 2026110551 sampled source IDs; 2026110754 model; 2026110755 shuffle; fixed cached epochs 01-10 and 20; frozen base seed 2026092701
rows.scenario: seven Phase1 source scenes, then seven Phase1 final test views if source IQ selects a candidate
rows.budget_ref: source IDs excluding all rx4/6/8 day3 and 4096 fixed sampled IDs, batch32, 10 source epochs
rows.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261102-phase1-direct-axial-iq-s2026092701-r01-release/experiments/phase1_axial_spectral/phase1_axial_spectral_pipeline.py --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --run-root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261102-phase1-direct-axial-iq-s2026092701-r01 --commit bc9ac03f23271614f332fd06bd86e77a0cd2cca5 --device cuda:0

notes: No classifier weights, DURA, classifier outputs, TX labels, V, or target IQ accessed during source training or IQ selection.
Tri-SIG-TIME SSL loaded only after source IQ selection; DURA used only as a fixed matched comparator.
Source validation and heldout receiver/day exclusions apply only to the new model; F or other historical experts may have seen these source IDs.
Phase1 development test observed repeatedly; not independent blind or real satellite evaluation.
